name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
label: Quest
description: Cap of the Scarlet Savant: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A finer cap you may never see. From the pristine hide of the beast, our expert crafters will create the most phenomenal hat a prestidigitator could ever hope to don!
Fifty gold pieces along with the listed items and your head shall be graced with the Cap of the Scarlet Savant:

clips.title: Progress
paras: Unless you've got everything I need, you're wasting my time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Astounding! It must have taken weeks to gather those components... And how did you find a pristine hide?!?
